text: The wind on Neptune is supersonic. Stay, and I'll show you how fast. Clouds of frozen methane race past at over two thousand kilometres an hour. Earth's strongest winds barely reach four hundred. And out here, thirty times farther from the Sun, there's hardly any sunlight to drive it. And still…
